sophie: Heads-up — after flipping vega-13b to the 4-bit qconfig in prod today we're seeing two things from customers: short prompts sometimes repeat a token sequence and p95 latency for <32-token responses jumped ~40ms. Not network-wide. Repro steps below. :eyes:

sophie: repro command (local harness):
```
python eval_harness/run.py --model vega-13b --quant 4bit --prompt \"Hello\" --n 1 --max_tokens 16
```

devon: can you paste a raw output example with the repetition? any non-ascii/escaped tokens?

sophie: example from logs: `Hello! Hello! Hello!` (should be single greeting). Also seen stray `\u0123` in one sample.

mike: do we have KV-cache enabled for the q4 runtime? last-minute change to fused-kv in the 4bit path landed yesterday.

ana: @mike that change only gated on long-seq paths AFAIK, but maybe the gating logic mis-detects short prompts.

mike: ok will check gating conditions. tagging infra to see latency shift in fleet metrics.

quant-bot: Quant job #q-2026-04-07 for vega-13b q4 completed. Metrics: rmse=0.021, kl=0.003, checkerboard=FAIL(small).

rebecca: if checkerboard flagged maybe quantized matmul layout is off — could cause tokenization mismatch if ops reorder. Worth rolling canary back to q8 for safety.

devon: quick triage plan: 1) reproduce locally with the exact quant artifact hash 2) run with kv-cache off 3) run with q8 vs q4 4) check fused-kv gating 5) route traffic to fallback model if customer-facing regressions > 5%

sophie: I can run (1) and (2) now — I'll attach exact artifact: vega-13b@sha256:4f9c...

mike: I suspect fused-attn kernel miscompiled for small seqlen; will run microbench and diff kernel selection logs.

rebecca: I'll prepare a rollback patch and a routing rule to send short prompts to vega-13b-q8 fallback until we confirm.

ana: also add evals quickset: repetition and unicode tests, run on canary and prod samples.

sophie: thanks. assigning owners: sophie -> repro + sample gathering, mike -> kernel/gating, rebecca -> rollback + routing, devon -> evals + metric thresholds. Will update here with findings. :thumbsup:
